text:
samir: quick question for packaging — single package + conditional exports or split into @redwood/sdk + @redwood/sdk-cjs? edge runtimes require ESM, many node users still use require. types entry point is confusing for customers.

marta: single-package wins on DX. fewer release docs to maintain. conditional exports are annoying but better UX overall.

liang: watch bundlers. conditional exports can break bun/deno/old rollups unless you include explicit subpaths and a fallback. also edge needs a shim for auth (no fs/kms).

ben_s: types are the pain point. TS resolver + exports map + typesVersions can be unpredictable. pointing "types" to ./dist/index.d.ts and using typesVersions for older TS usually helps.

nadia: we hit a customer bug where retry logic retried a non-idempotent request on Vercel Edge because our edge code used same retry config as node. Documenting edge auth/retry differences is a must.

samir: can someone paste a minimal package.json snippet we can try in a prototype?

liang: rough example:
{"exports": {".": {"import": "./esm/index.js", "require": "./cjs/index.js"}, "./edge": {"import": "./edge/index.js"}, "./package.json": "./package.json"}, "main": "./cjs/index.js", "module": "./esm/index.js", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"}

marta: also drop root index.cjs and index.mjs files that re-export into dist. some old tools look for those.

ci-bot: CI note: conditional exports behave differently across node/npm versions. pin runners in the matrix (18/20) and add smoke tests: require in CJS runner, import in ESM runner, run in Cloudflare worker and Next Edge. add a tsc --noEmit check for examples.

publish-bot: ops note: splitting packages doubles release surface/CVE maintenance. prefer single-package unless DX is significantly worse.

ben_s: if we do single-package, add an examples/ folder: examples/sdk-node-cjs and examples/sdk-edge to reduce onboarding friction. include a types smoke test that resolves from package root.

samir: OK i'll prototype single-package with dual root entry files, exports map, edge subpath, types -> ./dist/index.d.ts, examples, and a smoke matrix. will open a WIP PR and tag this thread. :rocket:
